sample_boundary.ordering: calendar order; include every listed race and do not substitute, omit, or reorder rows
sample_boundary.preflight: every listed race must be present in the cache with complete load status and must not be out of sample before prediction starts
sample_boundary.training: cutoff prediction inputs use only earlier completed in-sample races and the current cutoff-visible snapshot; final outcomes are unavailable to prediction generation

randomness.pace_fit_seed_scope: shared by all drivers at one race and cutoff

cutoff_and_target.cutoff: after the leader completes cutoff_lap; cutoff 0 is pre-race
cutoff_and_target.target: for each eligible driver, the next-to-complete lap, lap_number = laps_done_at_cutoff + 1
target_mask: the target lap is not visible as completed in the cutoff snapshot
the target lap is completed in the race and passes the same clean-lap classifier used by the linear pace model
predictors use only cutoff-known current compound and tire age plus one, and the driver's next lap number
target compound matches the cutoff-known compound; when the snapshot exposes a current stint, target stint must match it
paired pace comparisons use identical rows with finite model and baseline predictions and finite target time
cutoff_and_target.observation_rule: freeze the complete prediction trace before opening final results; missing or ineligible targets affect that race's explicit denominator and never remove its registered race row

metrics.podium_brier: binary outcome finish_position <= 3; unclassified starters count as failures; average rows within each race, then weight races equally
metrics.top10_brier: binary outcome finish_position <= 10; unclassified starters count as failures; average rows within each race, then weight races equally
metrics.paired_probability_mask: model and past-only grid baseline share identical finite prediction and observed-row masks
metrics.finish_interval_90: inclusive empirical inverted-CDF P05/P95 endpoints; coverage is evaluated only for classified finishers
metrics.team_strategy_comparison: compare each observed pit event with the latest recommendation strictly before its in-lap and not already visible at the selected cutoff; signed timing error is planned_stop_lap minus observed in_lap; agreement means the top action begins with pit
metrics.wear_band_retrospective_proxy: Phase 6 fuel-plus-compound fit on race-end laps excluding the evaluated driver stint; label as retrospective proxy, not latent ground truth
metrics.aggregation: equal race weight after within-race observation means
metrics.uncertainty: paired 95% percentile bootstrap resampling whole races; strategy comparison uses race as its resampling unit
metrics.empty_race_rule: preserve the registered race row and its zero or unavailable denominators; do not substitute another race

report_schema.required_race_rows: one ordered row for every registered race ID
report_schema.required_era_rows: per-era summaries include every era represented in the locked sample
report_schema.required_denominators: each reported metric includes its overall and per-race observation counts; era summaries include their contributing race and observation counts
report_schema.out_of_sample_era: reg_2026 is reported separately in the later holdout report

holdout_boundary.training: use only earlier 2023-2025 in-sample completed races plus the current holdout cutoff snapshot; never train on another 2026 holdout race
holdout_boundary.result_access: the dedicated holdout evaluator is the only results door; access once after the holdout lock and implementation are committed
holdout_boundary.score_policy: score once and never tune or rescore against the holdout

lock_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators after removing this lock_digest field
